name: bh-monetization-woo/tests-integration
description: Dev-only. Real-database integration tests for this plugin's money paths, run against @wordpress/env's tests-cli container (real WordPress + real MySQL) rather than the plugin's own pure-logic tests/ suite. Never installed at runtime, never shipped -- deploy-ftp.yml's FTP sync doesn't touch this directory's vendor/ since it isn't part of the plugin's own composer.json (this plugin ships no runtime Composer dependencies at all).
